implementation: Standalone address routing, shared retrieval/readers and atomic FAQ publication/rollback verified locally.
scope: Step 5; no production deployment, answer generation or UI change.
evaluation_notes: Frozen benchmark files were not changed. Target quote comparison normalizes whitespace because CIRS preserves PDF line breaks.
Logical CIRS target IDs and quotes match the selected published CIRS preparation; the golden fixture recorded the earlier preparation of the same source text.
All 66 query embeddings came from one saved real OpenAI response (1965 tokens); per-query service calls replay that response. Replay usage is not another billed API call.

Legacy CIRS single-snapshot checks retain top-5 target/quote and status checks; shared corpus checks additionally expose leaving-residency-pt failing. This is not a claim that every historical expansion diagnostic was rerun live.
No final generated answers or clickable UI links are claimed; they belong to Step 6.
One mixed scenario fails in all four languages: CIRS 15(1) ranks 117-129, outside the unchanged candidate window of 50. Token budget is not limiting.
No source quotas, target rewrites or ranking boosts were introduced to force benchmark success. Acceptance remains open.
